title: feat(app-shell): Data pillar — object header buttons, seven flat tabs with a 1000 px fold, flush Records body (objectui#12450)
body:
Fixes #12450
Clause-②: no

The Data pillar's content column, after the layout skeleton (objectui#12459): the object header gets its two icon buttons, the five power panels become flat tabs that fold back into "Advanced ▾" below a 1000 px content column, and the Records tab loses the framed card and body padding around the list. Part of epic objectui#12446 (decisions 1, 3 and B).

## What changed

**Object header** (`DataPillar` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`)
- Adds an **Object settings** icon button. It opens the Settings panel, so it still works when Settings is folded into Advanced.
- Adds a **More actions** icon button with a menu. Both buttons are 32 px and carry an `aria-label`.
- **Add field** moves from the header row into the More menu. The artboard has no header Add field. The grid's "+" column header and the form designer's own button still add fields.
- More is drawn only when its one entry is offered: a writable package, the object loaded, and the Records or Form tab.

**Tab row**
- Ruling B (maintainer, 2026-10-15): seven flat tabs — Records, Form, Validations, Hooks, Actions, API, Settings — when the content column is at least 1000 px wide. Narrower, the last five fold into "Advanced ▾", which keeps its objectui#11794 name rule.
- A CSS container query decides the fold. The content column is `@container`. The five flat tabs carry `hidden @min-[1000px]:inline-flex` and the trigger carries `@min-[1000px]:hidden`.
- So the fold also follows the field inspector: at 1280 px with the inspector open, the column is 740 px and the tabs fold. There is no JS width read.
- The rule and its class strings live in the new `dataTabsFold.ts`.
- Premise B re-checked on `cf430cd` before building: `advancedDataTabs` held exactly `rules` (Validations), `hooks`, `actions`, `api` and `settings`.

**Records body**
- The grid view's `main` drops `px-6 py-4` and the list's `rounded-lg border` card. The toolbar, grid and footer run flush with the column.
- Error and held-edit strips keep a 24 px inset in that view. Every other view keeps the padded body; the Form tab body is untouched (objectui#12451).

**Records toolbar** (`renderStudioGridList`)
- The Studio list uses the wide form, `compactToolbar: false`: Hide fields, Filter, Group and Sort as labelled buttons, then Refresh, Search and Add record.
- The console list pages keep the bundled Display form (objectui#12423).
- Density is turned off, because the artboard has no density control.
- The toggles move from the retired bare `show*` spellings to `userActions`. The slot's own `userActions` still wins.

**List search button** (`packages/plugin-list`, the toolbar's producer)
- The icon-only Search trigger gets an `aria-label`, in the same two-attribute shape as Refresh. Card acceptance 3 asks for one on every icon-only toolbar button.
- With a keyword active, the button's accessible name is now "Search: KEYWORD" instead of the bare keyword.
- This file is outside the claim's file surface. The dispatch allows a fix at the producer when the producer is in another package. It is one attribute.

## Deviations from the artboard (`data-records.png`)

1. **Toolbar arrangement.** The controls sit in the list's right-aligned rounded cluster. The artboard has left-aligned 28 px outline chips after an "N records" count, then Search and Refresh, a divider, and Add record as a primary-soft chip.
   - In the cluster Refresh comes before Search, and Add record is a ghost button.
   - Reason: the toolbar is `ListView`'s (`packages/plugin-list`), not plugin-grid's as the card assumed. Its controls hold `ListView`-internal state: filters, sort, grouping, hidden fields, search keyword and refresh key. A host toolbar cannot drive that state, so suppression alone would remove the controls.
   - Restyling `ListView`'s toolbar is outside the claimed surface. It is raised as an open question in the dev report.
2. **Grid metrics.** The header row is 48 px on the background surface; the artboard has 36 px on the sidebar surface. Body rows measure 41 px; the artboard has 40 px.
   - The `#` column is a 40 px cell with the number centred, about 16 px into the column. The artboard has a 48 px column with a 24 px inset, so **card acceptance 1 (title edge = row-number edge at 24 px) is not met**.
   - A vertical divider follows only the frozen first column.
   - Lookup cells render as primary links, not 20 px initials avatars, and the autonumber column is not mono.
   - Reason: these are `ObjectGrid` / data-table internals (`packages/plugin-grid`, `packages/components`). The card's surface admits plugin-grid only for a toolbar option. Same open question.
3. **Footer.** "N records" only, at 8 px by 16 px padding, with no range on the right. The artboard has "N records" plus "1–10 of 10" at 10 px by 24 px. Reason: this is `ListView`'s record-count bar. Same open question.
4. **More button.** It is not drawn on a read-only package, before the object loads, or on the five power panels. Add field is its only entry and is not offered there.
5. **Sample data.** The screenshots use a writable "Acme CRM" base seeded on a local backend.
   - Under `objectstack dev`, HotCRM's package is read-only and the server refuses to duplicate it (`DUPLICATE_SOURCE_NOT_A_BASE`). A read-only package draws no More button.
   - So the object, columns and rows differ from the artboard's HotCRM sample.
   - The shell header (app chip, pillar control with More, Create app) is the skeleton's, and objectui#12452's and objectui#12453's to change.

## Screenshots (1280 px, local console on its own backend)

- After, light: `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/12450-data-records-light.png`
- After, dark: `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/12450-data-records-dark.png`
- The fold, light, 1180 px viewport (940 px column): `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/12450-data-records-folded-light.png`
- Before: `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/skeleton-data-records-light.png` and `-dark.png`, from `cf430cd`, as filed by the skeleton change. These were not re-shot.

Measured in that browser run (Chromium, 1280 × 900):
- With a 1040 px content column, the seven tabs are displayed and the Advanced trigger is not.
- With a 940 px column, Records and Form plus Advanced are displayed.
- With the field inspector open at 1280 px (a 740 px column), the tabs fold.
- Every displayed toolbar button has a visible label or an `aria-label` (Refresh, Search).

## Tests (all at `4c06d3a`, from the worktree root, through the shared verify lock)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` in two runs:
  - the 98 files that are not `StudioDesignSurface.*`: `Test Files 98 passed (98)`, `Tests 773 passed (773)`;
  - the 76 `StudioDesignSurface.*` files: `Test Files 76 passed (76)`, `Tests 511 passed (511)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/`: `Test Files 133 passed (133)`, `Tests 1432 passed (1432)`. Run after the plugin-list change; that file has not changed since.
- Tests that read the search trigger, in app-shell and plugin-list (6 files): 214 passed.
- **New:** `DataPillar.flatTabs-12450.test.tsx` (9 tests).
  - It pins the flat state: the order of the seven tabs, the content column as the query container, the five flat tabs' fold classes, the trigger's class, and that both class strings name `DATA_TABS_FOLD_WIDTH`.
  - It also pins that a flat tab opens its panel while the folded trigger mirrors it, the header buttons' `aria-label`s, More holding Add field, and the read-only control.
- **Ablated once:** the flat tabs' `className={DATA_TAB_FLAT_ONLY}` was replaced with `className={undefined}` through `ablation-replace.mjs`.
  - The anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob changed.
  - Result: `Tests 1 failed | 8 passed (9)`, and the failure is the fold-class pin.
  - It was restored to the HEAD blob, with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Kept for the folded state, unchanged:** `DataPillar.advancedKeepsName-11794.test.tsx`, green.
- **Existing suites whose harness changed, assertions untouched:**
  - Each step that added a field through the header now opens More first (shared helper `__tests__/dataPillarAddField.ts`). Each step that clicked a power panel by name now clicks its flat tab.
  - Three suites mock the menu as passthrough buttons, which would now draw a second button of the same name.
  - Two suites asked "is Add field offered" through the header button's title. They now read the More trigger, which is drawn exactly when Add field is offered. `DataPillar.flatTabs-12450` pins that both ways.
  - The files: `DataPillar.authorRefusal-11785`, `choiceWithoutOptions-11253`, `designerRegistryPopulated`, `gridProjection`, `heldIncomplete-11786`, `inspectorBelongsToView-11781`, `panelGate`, `picklistServedOptions-10202`, and `StudioDesignSurface.autosaveInFlight-11204`, `autosaveSwitch-11232`, `cancelledLoad-11331`, `draftVersionConflict-11773`, `formFields`, `gridColumns`.
  - Three of these are on the card's stay-green list: `gridProjection`, `gridColumns` and `inspectorBelongsToView-11781`. All are green. `hiddenSystemFields-11780`, `surfaceRequest` and `listViewInspector-11823` are unchanged and green.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/plugin-list type-check`: both echo `type-check` and exit 0. Dependency closure built first. `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test and helper.
- eslint on every touched file in both packages: 0 errors. The warnings are existing patterns on untouched lines.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list --filter @object-ui/app-shell build`: exit 0. The `aria-label` is in `plugin-list/dist/index.js`, and the fold classes are in `app-shell/dist/.../dataTabsFold.js`.
- Gates, exit 0 each: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check:test-path-roots`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` reports NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- **Stretched last row (seen, not filed).** In Studio on HotCRM's `crm_account` at 1280 × 900, the grid drew 6 of the 9 rows the footer counts, and the 6th row stretched to the bottom. The before-screenshot from `cf430cd` shows the same shape. The 8-row Acme object does not do it. Not root-caused and not filed. Carrier: none.
- **Narrow-screen labels (inference from source, not measured).** Below the `sm` breakpoint, the list toolbar's Filter and Sort buttons hide their labels and carry no `aria-label`, in both toolbar forms. Carrier: none.
- **Merge state.** `origin/main` moved three commits after `cf430cd`; none of them touches this diff's files.

i18n: `engine.studio.data.objectSettings` and `engine.studio.data.moreActions` are added in en and zh. Changeset: `.changeset/12450-data-pillar-layout.md` (app-shell minor, plugin-list patch).
